observations: Photo 0: A black PlayStation 4 console with a controller and multiple cables (HDMI, power, USB) on a wooden floor. The PS4 logo is visible on top.
Photo 1: Front view of the same console on a white background. The 'SONY' logo is visible on the left, and the 'PS4' logo on the right. The disc slot is closed.
Photo 2: Close-up of the rear panel showing ports: power, HDMI out, Ethernet, USB, and a label with model and serial info. The label is partially readable but mirrored and blurry.

claims.evidence: No system software version is visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Games installed including fc26 and efootball
claims.evidence: No screen or internal storage view is provided. Games cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, HDMI output)
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting to home screen, and playing a game.

risks.risk: System software version 12.00 may be false or outdated, affecting game compatibility or online play
risks.proof: Screenshot of the system settings showing the software version.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated/invalid, affecting usability
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games (FC26, eFootball) and their icons.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Clear photo of the serial number and model number from the rear label, and a video of the console booting with the Sony logo.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting to the home screen.
Screenshot of the system settings showing the software version.
Screenshot of the home screen showing installed games (FC26, eFootball).
Clear photo of the rear label with model and serial number.
response.reason: The console is identifiable as a Sony PS4, but critical claims about software version and installed games cannot be verified from photos. Hidden risks include non-functionality, outdated software, and missing games. Proof is needed to assess true value.
